headlines.title: ADB, 韓 성장전망 0.6%P 올려 3.2%

headlines.title: 서울 아파트거래 22%가 6억 이하 …정책대출 커트라인에 몰렸다
headlines.summary: 1만709건 거래…전년동기比 11% 급등 6억 초과하면 디딤돌대출 등 못 받아 매수세에 가격↑…“저가 아파트 소멸” 올해 서울에서 거래된 아파트 5채 중 1채 이상이 ‘6억원 이하’인 것으로 나타났다. 전셋값 급등에 대출 문턱마저 높아지자, 정책대출을 받을 수 있는 시세 6억원 이하의 집으로 매수세가 몰린 것으로 풀이된다.

headlines.title: 거래 말랐는데 신고가는 속출 …“ 2022년 급락장과는 다르다 ”
headlines.summary: 서울 아파트 거래량 석달새 62.8% 급감 역대 최고가 이어져…서울 외곽 급속 확산 가격하락 앞서 거래량 감소 과거 사례에도 “공급 부족·대출 제한에 시장 영향 제한적” 서울 아파트 매매 거래가 급감한 가운데, 신고가 거래는 곳곳에서 속출하고 있다. 하지만 시장에선 거래량 감소가 급격한 가격 조정으로 이어지긴 어려울 것으로 내다보고 있다.

headlines.title: 강남 넘어 오금동도 공사비 3.3㎡당 1000만원 육박
headlines.summary: ‘천정부지’ 치솟는 서울 재건축 공사비 송파구 오금현대 평당 962만원 제시 목동4·13단지 등 곳곳서 1000만원 공사비 급등에 분양가 1년새 34% 상승 반포·여의도·압구정 등 한강변 핵심 정비사업지를 넘어 서울 곳곳에서 3.3㎡(평)당 1000만원 안팎의 공사비 사례가 나타나고 있다.

headlines.title: 정부, 非중동 원유 수입부과금 환급 확대조치 재시행

headlines.title: [금융현미경]유가·금리·경기… 추석 전후 韓 환율 향방 최대 변수는

headlines.title: 인구감소 · 주택거래 둔화 … 8월 이동자 수 53년 만에 최소
headlines.summary: ▲ 서울 아파트 인구 감소 흐름에 주택 거래까지 둔화하면서 8월 국내 이동자 수가 같은 달 기준으로 53년 만에 가장 적었습니다. 국가데이터처가 오늘(23일) 발표한 '8월 국내인구이동 통계'를 보면 지난달 국내 이동자 수는 47만1천명으로 1년 전보다 4.5%(2만2천명) 감소했습니다.

key_headlines.title: OECD Raises South Korea's 2026 Growth Forecast to 3.7% - Largest Upward Revision Among G20
key_headlines.summary: International organizations including OECD and ADB have significantly raised Korea's economic growth forecasts due to strong semiconductor exports and expected consumer recovery. The semiconductor boom is driving robust export and production growth this year, with consumption recovery anticipated next year.

key_headlines.title: Won-Dollar Exchange Rate Falls to 1,350 Won Level as Oil Price Volatility Becomes Key Variable
key_headlines.summary: The won-dollar exchange rate has declined again to around 1,350 won as declining oil prices, driven by eased US-Iran tensions and expectations of increased Saudi oil exports, become the primary factor determining exchange rate direction. Continued semiconductor export strength helps control won appreciation.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Prices Rise 85 Consecutive Weeks, Matching Record - 22% of Transactions Below 600 Million Won
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment prices have risen for 85 consecutive weeks, matching the longest bull run record, with over 22% of transactions concentrated in properties below 600 million won due to policy loan eligibility cutoffs. Strong demand for lower-priced apartments has driven prices upward while rental prices also surge.

key_headlines.title: Korea-US Nuclear Power Project: 8 Reactors Including Korean APR1400 Under Review
key_headlines.summary: Korea and the US are jointly pursuing construction of 8 nuclear reactors, including 6 Westinghouse AP1000 units and 2 Korean APR1400 reactors, as a major US investment project. This initiative opens opportunities for Korean nuclear technology's market entry into the United States.

key_headlines.title: LG Electronics Becomes Official NVIDIA AI Data Center Cooling Partner
key_headlines.summary: LG Electronics has been officially designated as an NVIDIA partner network member in the power and cooling segment for AI data centers. This partnership expands LG's access to global AI data center customers and opportunities to deploy its high-efficiency cooling solutions.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economic prospects have brightened significantly with major international organizations upgrading growth forecasts. The OECD raised Korea's 2026 growth projection to 3.7% and the ADB to 3.2%, citing strong semiconductor sector performance and anticipated consumer recovery. However, concerns persist about inflation potentially reaching the 3% threshold amid elevated oil prices. The semiconductor boom is delivering robust export growth while domestic demand is expected to recover gradually, supporting overall economic momentum through next year.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Global economic indicators present mixed signals as inflation and growth concerns dominate policy discussions. The US faces persistent inflation pressures despite economic growth, with JP Morgan warning of potential stagflation risks if high oil prices continue. Argentina's economy contracted 2.9% in July economic activity, raising recession concerns after consecutive quarters of negative GDP growth. Climate-related water infrastructure challenges are emerging as significant long-term GDP growth risks, with potential for 3.2 percentage point growth reductions from extreme flooding events. Policy responses must balance growth support with inflation management as central banks navigate divergent priorities.
sections.Financial Markets: US treasury yields have surged to 20-year highs, but equity markets have shown surprising resilience as the traditional negative correlation between rising rates and stock prices weakens. The AI boom appears to be reshaping market dynamics, with strong nominal growth justifying higher yield levels despite tighter monetary policy. Investors await key US inflation and employment data to gauge future Federal Reserve policy direction, with these indicators critical for determining additional rate hikes. The Kospi faces potential headwinds from higher US Treasury rates and global volatility, though semiconductor strength provides support for Korean equities.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's manufacturing sector shows improving sentiment with the fourth-quarter business survey index rising to 86, marking consecutive quarterly gains driven by semiconductor and cosmetics exports. Semiconductor sentiment reached record highs with a BSI of 139, reflecting exceptional industry strength, while shipbuilding, pharmaceuticals, and biotech also surpass benchmark levels. However, 60% of manufacturers expect 2026 operating profit targets will fall short due to rising production costs. The automotive, steel, and shipbuilding sectors face labor strike risks that could impact earnings, particularly with new IFRS18 accounting standards coming in 2027. EV battery recycling and secondary use in energy storage systems are gaining traction as industries seek value recovery.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices have risen for 85 consecutive weeks, matching the longest bull run on record, with unprecedented concentration of transactions below 600 million won driven by policy loan eligibility requirements. October nationwide apartment supply reaches 38,032 units across 50 complexes, 61% higher than the previous year, providing increased options for prospective buyers. While strong housing demand persists due to inflation concerns and expected price appreciation, rising interest rates and tighter lending conditions are creating affordability challenges for buyers. Strong demand for public and private development projects indicates sustained buyer interest despite higher financing costs.
sections.International Economy: The US Federal Reserve increased rates to 3.75-4.00% while establishing an AI task force to study economic implications, reflecting Jerome Powell's focus on artificial intelligence impacts on demand-side economics. US-China relations show diplomatic progress with the announcement of bilateral trade and investment committee activation, though no major trade agreements emerged beyond preliminary tariff reductions. The Trump administration is eliminating aggressive EV mandates, signaling a shift toward market-driven vehicle production decisions that could favor domestic automakers. Treasury Secretary Bessent subtly urged the Fed to maintain flexibility on future rate hikes, invoking 1990s precedents of accommodative monetary policy during boom periods.
sections.AI & Economy: South Korea's policy financial institutions are mobilizing substantial funding for physical AI industry development, with the Korea Development Bank creating a 300 billion won innovation fund and industrial banks offering up to 15-year low-interest loans. LG Electronics achieved official partnership status with NVIDIA's partner network for AI data center cooling solutions, expanding its market access for high-efficiency cooling systems. Korea Aerospace Industries, Mexican aerospace associations, and POSCO International signed trilateral MOU to strengthen Mexico's aerospace ecosystem and accelerate FA-50 export market expansion into Central and North America. Government and corporate initiatives demonstrate comprehensive support for AI ecosystem development through funding, partnerships, and technology commercialization efforts.
sections.Others: Foreign investors and retail investors displayed opposite investment strategies in September, with foreigners concentrating on leveraged ETFs while retail investors favored inverse index funds, resulting in foreign investor outperformance. China is reportedly considering allowing Alibaba and ByteDance to purchase NVIDIA's new chips, reflecting ongoing US-China semiconductor trade negotiations. Over 60% of Korean manufacturers report expected 2026 operating profit shortfalls due to rising production costs, despite improved business sentiment. Sri Lanka faces extreme high-skilled youth unemployment at 43%, the highest in Asia, indicating significant structural economic challenges distinct from regional peer economies.
